abstract: This is a directory index page from the Bureau of Labor Statistics providing links to May 2024 Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) data organized by metropolitan and nonmetropolitan areas across all U.S. states and territories. The page serves as a navigational resource for accessing detailed occupational employment and wage estimates for specific geographic regions.
keyFindings: The source is a directory index rather than a research document with substantive findings.
Data presented is from May 2024 OEWS survey covering all U.S. metropolitan and nonmetropolitan areas.
Comprehensive geographic coverage includes all 50 states plus Puerto Rico and cross-state metropolitan areas.
methodology: This is an index/directory page for the Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) program. The actual methodology for the underlying data is not described on this page, but users are directed to access May 2024 metropolitan and nonmetropolitan area estimates, national estimates, state estimates, and industry-specific estimates through linked resources. A downloadable XLSX file of MSA definitions is available.
qualifiers: This is an index page, not a research study. The actual occupational employment and wage data is accessible through linked pages. The excerpt provided in the request about AI roles ($157K in hub metros) does not appear in the source text provided and may be from a different BLS analysis. Data is current as of May 2024, with page last modified July 23, 2025.
